name: Dark Green Glass Olive Oil Bottle with Steel Pour Spout
description: A tall, slender, square-shouldered bottle in deep forest-green glass filled with golden-green olive oil, fitted at the neck with a bare brushed-stainless free-flow pour spout, and wrapped at the mid-body with a wide band of uncoated oat-white paper.
materials: Deep forest-green glass bottle with square shoulders; bare brushed-stainless free-flow pour spout with a hinged flip lid; wide uncoated oat-white paper band left blank and unprinted; golden-green olive oil filling
primaryColors: Deep forest-green glass, golden-green oil, oat-white uncoated paper, brushed stainless silver
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, printing, sticker, engraving, or emblem on the glass, the paper band, or the steel spout; keep the paper band entirely blank with only its natural fiber texture; never replace the pour spout with a cork, screw cap, or dropper; never make the glass clear, amber, or fully opaque, it stays deep translucent forest green; never change the bottle to a round-shouldered, squat, or tapered-flask form; no props, hands, or presenter in frame. Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: Keep the bottle's tall slender square-shouldered proportions, the deep forest-green glass tone and the way it glows translucent where light passes through the golden-green oil, the bare brushed-stainless spout and flip-lid geometry, and the oat-white paper band's height and vertical position identical across all four angles; the paper band is wrapped and glued to the OUTSIDE of the bottle and must always read as sitting clearly on the exterior glass surface, never floating inside the oil. When the art direction explicitly names a mark on this product, that named mark is part of the product's identity for that shot and overrides the blank-surface requirement.
